repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built in Python, providing a local-first dashboard to monitor agent activity.
Tracks granular metrics including token usage, time spent, files modified, and tool execution.
Integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to provide transparency into development costs.
Enables financial oversight for engineering teams utilizing autonomous coding workflows.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A local-first A-share market sentiment and short-term trading dashboard.
bullets: Python-based dashboard that computes market sentiment metrics locally without relying on AI for core calculations.
Visualizes complex market data like limit-up pools, liquidity flows, and sentiment cycles.
Uses AI exclusively for synthesizing data into readable market commentary.
Supports local execution, allowing users to bypass API costs for real-time market analysis.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, high-performance visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series.
bullets: Written in Rust, serving as a hard fork of Rerun optimized for robotics and time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support with the ability to ingest and visualize existing .rrd recording files.
Designed for high-throughput data streams, making it ideal for monitoring complex sensor or financial time-series data.
Provides a robust infrastructure for real-time observability in data-intensive environments.
